tasks.title: Manage your Tasks!
tasks.description: Guidance on organizing tasks, columns, and creating habits on the board.
tasks.subtitle: Organize your layout and keep your momentum.
tasks.bullet0: Organize your board by creating and dragging columns for each task context.
tasks.bullet1: Classify activities into Daily, Habit, and To-Do.
tasks.bullet2: Single-click a card to view details or double-click (DoubleClick) to open the edit task modal.

inventory.title: Your Backpack!
inventory.description: Instructions on items purchased in the shop and consumed in your inventory.
inventory.subtitle: Manage your acquired items and rewards.
inventory.bullet0: Store and organize all items and coupons redeemed in the Showcase.
inventory.bullet1: Use consumable items directly or send potions to the Focus Stage.
inventory.bullet2: Single-use items disappear from your backpack once fully consumed.
inventory.bullet2Gamified: Single-use items disappear from your backpack once fully consumed.
inventory.bullet2Productivity: Single-use items disappear from your inventory once fully consumed.

rewards.title: Claim your reward!
rewards.description: Tips on trading coins for coupons and custom rewards.
rewards.subtitle: Manage your Showcase and trade your coins.
rewards.bullet0: Trade your gold coins for real, custom rewards.
rewards.bullet1: Add new prizes to the Showcase: Coupons, Single-Use, or Mystery Boxes.
rewards.bullet2: Every redeemed item is transferred directly to your Backpack.
rewards.bullet2Gamified: Every redeemed item is transferred directly to your Backpack.
rewards.bullet2Productivity: Every redeemed item is transferred directly to your Inventory.

focus.title: Your Focus environment!
focus.description: Instructions for the Pomodoro timer, continuous stopwatch, and guided sessions.
focus.subtitle: Boost your daily productivity through guided sessions and gamified rewards.
focus.bullet0: Create important activities for your daily routine.
focus.bullet1: Track sessions using Pomodoro or Stopwatch.
focus.bullet2: View strategic metadata to optimize your routine.

history.subtitleGamified: Browse your history of gold, XP, and items earned on your adventures.
history.subtitleProductivity: Browse your detailed history of credits, points, and redemptions.
history.bullet0: Completing tasks, dailies, and habits logs coin and XP gains.
history.bullet1: Negative habit penalties and failures record balance deductions.
history.bullet2: Shop redemptions and backpack item usage are archived in this statement.
history.bullet2Gamified: Shop redemptions and backpack item usage are archived in this journal.
history.bullet2Productivity: Showcase redemptions and inventory item usage are archived in this statement.

cookieBanner.title: Privacy & Cookies
cookieBanner.description: We only use essential cookies to keep your session secure, authenticate your account, and preserve preferences such as theme, language, and workspace. We do not collect data for ads or third-party tracking.
